verdict.rationale: Flutterwave documents a broad first-party API covering many dashboard capabilities, such as bulk transfers, subscriptions/payment plans, subaccount splits, virtual accounts and FX. It also says users can 'build fully custom solutions using our APIs.' No parity claim exists, though, and several UI features (invoices, payment links, the ecommerce store builder) have no API evidence; no OpenAPI spec was found. Missing for 10: an explicit documented API–UI parity statement, API evidence for invoices, payment links and store creation, a published machine-readable OpenAPI spec, and independent corroboration of parity.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI
